id: 03_Why Do Routine Laser Maintenance -- Laser Maintenance Group Kiser
title: 为什么要做激光设备例行维护
source_doc: course/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/03_Why Do Routine Laser Maintenance -- Laser Maintenance Group Kiser.md
author_source: project/Laser Maintenance Group Safety/03_Why Do Routine Laser Maintenance -- Laser Maintenance Group Kiser/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在一张摆满激光零件的桌子旁，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a table covered with laser machine parts and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 激光设备为什么要例行维护？
overlay: 激光设备为什么要例行维护

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一张空白卡片，上面画着一个扳手和数字1
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank card with a wrench icon and the number one.
shots.narration: 这是维护小贴士的第一条。

shots.scene: 老周和老李坐在桌边，桌上放着拆下来的切割头部件
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer sit at a table with disassembled laser cutting head parts on it.
shots.narration: 老周请维修负责人老李来聊维护。

shots.scene: 老李手里转着一个黄铜镜座
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns a brass mirror mount over in his bare hands.
shots.narration: 老李一边摆弄零件，一边回答。

shots.scene: 老周掰着手指提问
shots.prompt_en: The older man counts on his fingers while asking a question.
shots.narration: 老周问：到底多久维护一次？

shots.scene: 桌上排着黄铜镜座、金黄色透镜、铜喷嘴和一段弯折的铜管
shots.prompt_en: On a black table: a brass mirror mount, a golden lens in a clear case, a copper nozzle and a bent copper tube. No people.
shots.narration: 桌上是切割头里拆下的零件。

shots.scene: 示意图：切割头剖面，镜片、喷嘴、冷却水管的位置
shots.prompt_en: A cross-section diagram of a laser cutting head showing where the mirror mount, lens, nozzle and cooling water tube sit. No people.
shots.narration: 镜座、透镜、喷嘴，还有冷却水管。

shots.scene: 老李翻过镜座，露出顶部水接头和中间透镜孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer flips the brass mount to show a water fitting on top and a lens opening in the middle.
shots.narration: 这些都是例行维护要检查的地方。

shots.scene: 老李翻开一本空白设备说明书，指着一页
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer opens a blank equipment manual and points at a page.
shots.narration: 原厂的要求是：每1000小时维护一次。

shots.scene: 运行计时器图标走到1000，弹出扳手图标
shots.prompt_en: A run-hour counter icon reaches one thousand and a wrench icon pops up. No people.
shots.narration: 机器每跑满1000小时，就该保养。

shots.scene: 说明书图标连到一个周期循环箭头
shots.prompt_en: A blank manual icon linked to a circular repeat arrow with a wrench. No people.
shots.narration: 维护要按周期，一轮接一轮。

shots.scene: 三台机器：一个班、两个班、三个班的图标
shots.prompt_en: Three machine icons labeled with one, two and three work shift symbols. No people.
shots.narration: 开一班、两班、三班，大不一样。

shots.scene: 一个太阳图标的机器慢慢走表，日历翻过半年
shots.prompt_en: A machine with a sun icon whose hour counter turns slowly while a calendar flips through six months. No people.
shots.narration: 只开一班，1000小时大约半年。

shots.scene: 两个10小时班接力，一天20小时
shots.prompt_en: Two shift icons of ten hours each side by side, adding up to a twenty-hour day. No people.
shots.narration: 老周的厂两班各10小时，一天20小时。

shots.scene: 日历上的维护标记从远处挪到很近
shots.prompt_en: A maintenance mark on a calendar moves from far away to only a few weeks ahead. No people.
shots.narration: 这样大约六周就到维护周期了。

shots.scene: 老周站在忙碌的车间里，指着运转的机器摇头
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands in a busy workshop pointing at a running machine and shaking his head.
shots.narration: 老周说：机器正忙，真不想停。

shots.scene: 一张被一推再推的日历图标
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon whose maintenance mark keeps getting pushed later and later. No people.
shots.narration: 生产一忙，维护就一拖再拖。

shots.scene: 老李把镜座翻过来，露出中间的透镜孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer turns the brass mount over to show the lens opening in the middle.
shots.narration: 老李说：这次坏的零件不算贵。

shots.scene: 一个小小的镜片图标，价格标签很小
shots.prompt_en: A small lens icon with a tiny blank price tag. No people.
shots.narration: 就零件本身来说，花不了多少钱。

shots.scene: 小镜片图标旁一个巨大的警告三角
shots.prompt_en: A small lens icon next to a huge warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 可后果，本来可能是灾难性的。

shots.scene: 一个大大的沙漏，旁边是停着的切割机
shots.prompt_en: A large hourglass next to a stopped laser cutting machine. No people.
shots.narration: 更大的代价，是停机的时间。

shots.scene: 日历上两天被划掉，再加一个扳手和时钟
shots.prompt_en: Two days crossed out on a calendar, then a wrench icon and a clock showing a few hours. No people.
shots.narration: 等两天人才进场，再修几个小时。

shots.scene: 机器重新启动、调试的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a machine being restarted and adjusted with a wrench and a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 修完还得把机器重新调起来。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现1000小时、日历、沙漏三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside three icons: a run-hour counter, a calendar and an hourglass.
shots.narration: 原厂要求每1000小时维护一次。

shots.scene: 老周和老李握手，桌上的零件摆放整齐
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the facility engineer shake hands over the table of neatly arranged parts.
shots.narration: 按运行小时算，别因为忙就拖。

shots.scene: 欣欣举着扳手挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a wrench and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 小贴士第一条就到这里，下次见！
